preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 0 and 5000 inclusive.
The capital city s is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range 1 to n.
The number of road pairs in the input matches the given m.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of new roads needed is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len([city for city in range(1, n+1) if city not in reachable_cities])
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of cities not reachable from the capital after adding the minimum number of new roads.
